title: Extraction of Plant-based Capsules for Microencapsulation Applications
protocol: Prepare a reflux set-up in a fume hood using a glass condenser, water circulation system, and water bath.
Weigh 100 g L. clavatum spores without creating dust and away from any ignition source.
Transfer the spores slowly to a 1 L PTFE round bottom flask with a magnetic stirring rod.
Add 500 ml acetone to the spores in the PTFE flask and shake gently to form a homogeneous suspension.
Place the PTFE flask in the water bath set at 50 °C and connect to the reflux condenser.
Perform refluxing in acetone for 6 hr with stirring at 200 rpm.
Allow the mixture to cool at room temperature.
Filter the suspension using filter paper under vacuum.
Collect the defatted spores in large (15 cm diameter) glass petri dishes.
Dry the spores at room temperature by covering them with aluminum foil that has holes for solvent evaporation.
Prepare 85% (v/v) phosphoric acid with deionized (DI) water.
Transfer defatted dry spores to a 1 L PTFE flask.
Add 500 ml of phosphoric acid (85% v/v) to the defatted spores.
Place the PTFE flask in a water bath set at 70 °C and connect to the reflux condenser.
Perform gentle refluxing (70 °C) for 30 hr and then allow to cool at room temperature.
Dilute the suspension using 500 ml warm DI water.
Collect the SECs by vacuum filtration using filter paper.
Transfer the SECs to a 3 L glass beaker.
Add 800 ml hot (50 °C) DI water to the SECs with gentle stirring for 10 min.
Filter the suspension by using filter paper and a vacuum filtration set-up.
Collect the SECs in a clean 3 L glass beaker.
Repeat steps 1.3.1. to 1.3.4 five times.
Add 600 ml hot (45 °C) acetone to the SECs with gentle stirring for 10 min.
Collect the SECs by filtration under vacuum and transfer the SECs to a clean 3 L glass beaker.
Repeat steps 1.3.6. and 1.3.7 using 600 ml hot (50 °C) 2 M hydrochloric acid.
Repeat steps 1.3.6. and 1.3.7 using 600 ml hot (45 °C) acetone.
Repeat steps 1.3.6. and 1.3.7 using 600 ml hot (45 °C) ethanol.
Repeat steps 1.3.6. and 1.3.7 using 800 ml hot (50 °C) DI water.
Transfer the clean SECs to six large glass petri dishes.
Dry in a fume hood at RT for 24 hr to remove all water content.
Dry the SECs in a vacuum oven at 60 °C and 1 mbar vacuum for 10 hr or until constant weight.
Transfer dried SECs to a polypropylene bottle.
Store the SECs in a dry cabinet.
Perform scanning electron microscopic analysis using spores and SECs produced at different stages.
Perform elemental analysis using spores and SECs produced at different stages.
Dry all samples at 60 °C for at least 1 hr before elemental analysis.
Calculate protein content using percent nitrogen with a multiplication factor of 6.25.
Obtain results using triplicate measurements for each sample.
Conduct micromeritic properties analysis using a dynamic image particle analyzer.
Scan unprocessed, processed, and FITC-BSA-loaded SECs using confocal laser scanning microscopy.
Prepare 1.2 ml of 125 mg/ml bovine serum albumin (BSA) solution using DI water.
Transfer the BSA solution to a 50 ml polypropylene tube.
Weigh 150 mg of SECs and transfer to the BSA solution.
Vortex the tube for 10 min to form a homogeneous solution.
Cover the tube using filter paper.
Transfer the tube to a freeze dryer flask.
Dry under vacuum at 1 mbar for 4 hr.
Remove agglomerates from the BSA-loaded SECs by using a mortar and pestle.
Transfer the BSA-loaded SECs to a 50 ml tube.
Add 2 ml DI water to remove residual BSA.
Collect SECs by centrifugation at 4,704 x g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Wash the collected SECs with DI water once.
Cover the tube containing BSA-loaded SECs using filter paper.
Transfer the SECs to a freezer (-20 °C) and freeze for 1 hour.
Freeze dry the SECs for 24 hours and store in a freezer until further characterization.
Prepare placebo SECs without BSA using the same procedure as steps 3.1. to 3.13.
Prepare FITC-BSA loaded SECs using the same procedure as steps 3.1. to 3.13.
Weigh 5 mg of BSA-loaded SECs in 2 ml polypropylene tubes.
Add 1.4 ml phosphate buffered saline pH 7.4 (PBS) and vortex for 5 minutes.
Probe sonicate the suspension at 40% amplitude for 3 cycles of 10 seconds each.
Filter the solution using a 0.45 µm Polyethersulfone (PES) filter.
Perform the same procedure as steps 4.1. to 4.4. using placebo SECs.
Measure the absorbance at 280 nm using placebo as a blank.
Quantify the amount of BSA encapsulated using a BSA standard curve (200 to 1,000 µg/ml) in PBS.
